items.title: Define Lattice primary asset naming contract
items.context: Document which paths are primary for new projects and which Koala paths remain legacy compatibility aliases.
items.userSees: 用户看到文档说明新项目使用 `LATTICE.md`, `bin/lattice.js`, `bin/lattice-codex.js`, `.Codex/lattice.json`；旧 `KOALA.md`, `bin/koala.js`, `bin/koala-codex.js`, `.Codex/koala.json` 仍可识别为 legacy。

happy.desc: Docs distinguish new Lattice primary paths from legacy Koala compatibility aliases.

edge.desc: Docs state new init should not silently delete existing Koala-named assets in old projects.

adversarial.desc: Docs avoid claiming runtime/production authority changes; this is managed asset naming only.

verificationEvidence.note: Lifecycle artifact scope now lists LATTICE.md, bin/lattice.js, bin/lattice-codex.js, and .Codex/lattice.json as new init primary paths, with KOALA.md/bin/koala*.js/.Codex/koala.json documented as legacy compatibility.
Docs state cleanup may remove a legacy Koala-named asset only when exact generated ownership is proven; user-owned legacy files are preserved.
Docs explicitly bound this to managed asset naming and state it does not change receipt-backed authority or lifecycle gates.

items.title: Implement Lattice-branded init output
items.context: Update init templates and wrapper generation so new projects write Lattice primary files and commands by default.
items.userSees: 用户运行 `lattice init --profile=codex --asset-mode=thin` 后看到生成 `LATTICE.md`, `bin/lattice.js`, `bin/lattice-codex.js`, `.Codex/lattice.json`，没有 `bin/koala*.js` 或 `.Codex/koala.json`。

happy.desc: New Codex thin init writes Lattice primary assets and omits Koala-named local wrappers/manifests.

edge.desc: Default/full init still materializes prompt assets while using Lattice-branded launchers and manifest paths.

adversarial.desc: Profile cleanup and thin init do not delete user-owned legacy Koala assets unless ownership is proven safe.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke asserts thin codex init creates LATTICE.md, bin/lattice.js, bin/lattice-codex.js, .Codex/lattice.json and does not create KOALA.md, bin/koala.js, bin/koala-codex.js, or .Codex/koala.json.
Same smoke covers default/full codex init: .Codex/agents is materialized while Lattice launchers and manifest remain primary.
Smoke seeds user-owned KOALA.md, bin/koala.js, bin/koala-codex.js, .Codex/koala.json, and .Codex/agents/user-owned.md before thin init and asserts they survive unchanged.

items.title: Preserve legacy Koala asset compatibility
items.context: Update managed asset detection/check and Codex verification to accept existing Koala-named files and wrappers while preferring Lattice paths for new assets.
items.userSees: 用户在旧项目里运行 `node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex` 仍能通过；新项目里运行 `node bin/lattice-codex.js verify_codex` 也能通过。

happy.desc: Legacy Koala manifest/wrapper paths remain accepted by check and verify.

edge.desc: When both Lattice and Koala manifest paths exist, verification prefers Lattice primary path and reports clear drift diagnostics.

adversarial.desc: Missing both primary and legacy paths fails clearly with recovery command that names the Lattice entrypoint.

items.title: Validate docs, init fixtures, and adapter verification
items.context: Add focused smoke coverage and run build plus Codex adapter verification to prove new names and legacy aliases both work.
items.userSees: 用户看到验证摘要包含 `✓ lattice branded init smoke passed`, `✓ legacy koala compatibility smoke passed`, `✓ build passed`, 和 `✓ Codex adapter checks passed`。

happy.desc: Focused smoke commands and TypeScript build pass.

edge.desc: Thin/full and legacy/new path combinations are covered by tests.

adversarial.desc: Codex adapter evidence is refreshed after changing adapter material paths.

auditLog.reason: Documented Lattice primary asset naming contract and Koala legacy compatibility boundary.
Implemented Lattice-branded init output and no-delete behavior for user-owned legacy Koala files.
